name: Canny
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Canny, collect feature requests, merge duplicates, publish statuses, and maintain a roadmap. The hard boundary is customer identity, integrations, changelog, prioritization, and team workflow, plus participant network, synthesis workflow, and collaboration.
